text: Maaɗun laatano maa suudu cuɗiraandu kanŋe e tanaa mun, maaɗun ƴeeŋaa ka kammu, men gomɗintaa wonnde ko o Nulaaɗo hay ƴeeguɗaa ton si wanaa si a jippodii e deftere winndaande immornde ka Alla, men jannga e nder mayre wonnde an ko a Nulaaɗo Alla. Maakan ɓe -ko an yo Nulaaɗo-: "Senaade wonanii Joomi an! Hara mi wonu si wonaa ɓanndinke Nulaaɗo wano denndaangal Nulaaɓe ɓen, mi maraa addugol hay e huunde, ko honno woniranta lan nde mi addata ko fewjanɗon mi kon?!"
